ابنا آدم والغراب: The Two Sons of Adam and the Crow
النخلة والرُّطَب: The Palm Tree and the Fresh Dates
قدّم ابنا آدم كلٌّ منهما قرباناً إلى الل: Each of the two sons of Adam offered a sacrifice to Allah. Allah accepted it from one of them and did not accept it from the other.
غضب الذي لم يُتقبَّل منه، وقال لأخيه: لأ: The one whose offering was not accepted became angry and said to his brother: "I will kill you!" His brother said calmly: "Allah only accepts from those who are mindful of Him."
قال الأخ الطيّب: لو مددتَ يدك إليّ لتقتل: The good brother said: "If you raise your hand against me to kill me, I will not raise mine against you to kill you. I fear Allah, the Lord of all worlds."
لكنّ نفسه زيّنت له القتل فقتل أخاه، وأصب: But his own self made the killing seem fine to him, so he killed his brother and became one of the losers.
فأرسل الله غراباً يحفر في الأرض ليُريَه: Then Allah sent a crow scratching the ground to show him how to cover his brother's body. He said in regret: "Woe to me! Was I unable to be like this crow?"
لا نحسد أحداً على نعمة الله، ولا نؤذي أح: We do not envy anyone for Allah's blessings, and we do not harm anyone.
We fear Allah and keep away from harming others, even when we are angry.
نتعلّم حتى من الطيور، وإذا أخطأنا نندم و: We learn even from birds, and when we make a mistake we feel sorry and return to Allah.
ماذا أرسل الله ليُري ابن آدم كيف يستر أخ: What did Allah send to show the son of Adam how to cover his brother?
ماذا قال الأخ الطيب؟: What did the good brother say?
إني أخاف الله ربّ العالمين: I fear Allah, the Lord of all worlds
سأنتقم منك: I will take revenge on you
من المتّقين: From those who are mindful of Him
كان أيوب عبداً صالحاً، أصابه مرضٌ وضرٌّ: Ayyub was a righteous servant. A severe illness and hardship afflicted him, but he was patient and turned to Allah. Allah described him as patient, an excellent servant.
ونادى أيوب ربّه: إني مسّني الضرّ وأنت أر: Ayyub called upon his Lord: "Hardship has afflicted me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful."
فاستجاب الله له، وقال له: اضرب الأرض برج: So Allah answered him and said: "Strike the ground with your foot. Here is cool water to wash with and to drink."
فكشف الله عنه ما به من ضرّ، وجاء الفرج ب: Allah removed the hardship from him, and relief came after patience.
وأعطاه الله أهله ومثلهم معهم، رحمةً منه: Allah gave him back his family and the like of them with them, as a mercy from Him and a reminder for people of understanding.
We are patient in illness and hardships and trust Allah.
We call on Allah alone, for He is the Most Merciful of the merciful.
ماذا قال أيوب في دعائه؟: What did Ayyub say in his supplication?
مسّني الضرّ وأنت أرحم الراحمين: Hardship has afflicted me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful
ماذا أمره الله أن يفعل؟: What did Allah tell him to do?
يضرب الأرض برجله فيخرج ماء بارد: Strike the ground with his foot and cool water comes out
ضرب الله مثلاً برجلين: جعل لأحدهما بستان: Allah gave an example of two men: to one of them He gave two gardens of grapevines and date palms, with crops between them, and He made a river flow between them.
فقال صاحب البستان لصاحبه وهو يحاوره: أنا: The owner of the garden said to his companion while talking with him: "I have more wealth than you and a stronger family!" He thought his garden would never perish.
فنصحه صاحبه المؤمن: هلّا قلتَ حين دخلت ب: His believing companion advised him: "Why did you not say, when you entered your garden: Masha Allah, there is no power except with Allah!"
فأهلك الله ثمر البستان، فأصبح خالياً، وأ: Then Allah destroyed the fruit of the garden and it became empty, and its owner kept wringing his hands in sorrow over what he had spent on it.
وقال: يا ليتني لم أشرك بربي أحداً! ولم ي: He said: "I wish I had not associated anyone with my Lord!" He had no one to help him besides Allah. Victory belongs to Allah, the True, and He gives the best reward.
نقول: ما شاء الله، لا قوة إلا بالله، حين: We say "Masha Allah, la quwwata illa billah" when we see a blessing.
Wealth is of no use against Allah.
We thank Allah for His blessings and are not arrogant toward anyone.
ماذا نقول حين نرى نعمة جميلة؟: What do we say when we see a beautiful blessing?
ما شاء الله، لا قوة إلا بالله: Masha Allah, there is no power except with Allah
من الذي أهلك ثمر البستان؟: Who destroyed the fruit of the garden?
جعل الله البيت الحرام مكاناً يرجع إليه ا: Allah made the Sacred House a place where people return and are safe.
وأمر الله إبراهيم وإسماعيل عليهما السلام: Allah commanded Ibrahim and Ismail, peace be upon them, to purify His House for those who circle it, those who stay there, and those who bow and prostrate.
ورفع إبراهيم وإسماعيل قواعد البيت، حجراً: Ibrahim and Ismail raised the foundations of the House, stone upon stone, working patiently and together.
وكانا يقولان: ربّنا تقبّل منّا، إنك أنت: And they said: "Our Lord, accept this from us. You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing."
ودعا إبراهيم: ربّ اجعل هذا البلد آمناً،: Ibrahim prayed: "My Lord, make this land safe, and provide its people with fruits."
We do good and ask Allah to accept it from us.
نتعاون في الأعمال الصالحة كما تعاون إبرا: We cooperate in good deeds as Ibrahim and Ismail cooperated.
The Kaaba is the House of Allah, and it is the direction we face in prayer.
من رفع قواعد البيت؟: Who raised the foundations of the House?
ماذا قالا بعد البناء؟: What did they say after building?

حملت مريم عليها السلام بأمر الله، فابتعد: Maryam, peace be upon her, conceived by Allah's command, and she withdrew to a faraway place.
وجاءها ألم الولادة إلى جذع النخلة، فقالت: The pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said: "I wish I had died before this!"
فناداها من تحتها: لا تحزني، قد جعل ربّك: A voice called her from beneath her: "Do not grieve. Your Lord has placed a small stream beneath you."
وقال لها: حرّكي جذع النخلة يسقط عليك رُط: And it said to her: "Shake the trunk of the palm tree and fresh ripe dates will fall upon you."

Allah cares for His servants and does not forget them in times of hardship.
نأخذ بالأسباب ونتوكّل على الله، كما أُمر: We take the means and rely on Allah, just as she was told to shake the palm tree.

ماذا أمرها الله أن تفعل بجذع النخلة؟: What was she told to do with the trunk of the palm tree?

سأل الناس عن ذي القرنين، وكان ملكاً صالح: People asked about Dhul-Qarnayn. He was a righteous ruler to whom Allah gave authority on earth and the means to everything.
وسار في الأرض حتى بلغ مغرب الشمس، فقال:: He travelled until he reached the place where the sun sets. He said: "Whoever does wrong, we will punish him; and whoever believes and does good will have the best reward, and we will speak kindly to him."
ثم بلغ بين جبلين، فوجد قوماً لا يكادون ي: Then he reached a place between two mountains and found a people who could hardly understand speech. They complained to him about the harm done by Yajuj and Majuj (Gog and Magog).
قال: ما أعطاني ربّي خيرٌ من مالكم، فأعين: He said: "What my Lord has given me is better than your payment. So help me with strength, and I will build a barrier between you and them."
فجاءوا بقطع الحديد حتى ملأوا ما بين الجب: They brought pieces of iron until they filled the space between the two mountains, lit a fire on it until it glowed red, and he poured molten copper over it.
فلم يستطيعوا أن يتسلّقوه ولم يقدروا على: They could not climb over it nor dig through it. He said: "This is a mercy from my Lord. When my Lord's promise comes, He will level it to the ground. My Lord's promise is true."
القوة والمال نعمة من الله نستعملها لنفع: Strength and wealth are blessings from Allah that we use to benefit people.
We say: "This is from my Lord's favour," and we are not arrogant.
سدّاً من الحديد والنحاس: A barrier of iron and copper
بماذا استعان على بنائه؟: What did he use to help build it?
بقوّة الناس وعملهم: The strength and work of the people
ماذا قال عند اكتماله؟: What did he say when it was complete?

كان لقومٍ حديقة جميلة مليئة بالثمار، وحل: A group of people had a beautiful garden full of fruit. They swore they would pick its fruit early in the morning, and they did not say "if Allah wills".
فمرّ عليها بلاء من ربّك وهم نائمون، فأصب: Then a calamity from your Lord struck it while they slept, and by morning it was like a dark night.
وفي الصباح نادى بعضهم بعضاً، ومشَوا وهم: In the morning they called to one another and walked off whispering: "No poor person shall enter it today."
فلمّا رأوها قالوا: إنّا لضالّون الطريق!: When they saw it they said: "We must have lost our way!" Then they said: "No, we have been deprived."
فقال أعدلهم: ألم أقل لكم لولا تسبّحون؟ ف: The fairest of them said: "Did I not tell you to glorify Allah?" They said: "Glory to our Lord! We were wrong."
وتلاوموا وقالوا: يا ويلنا إنّا كنّا طاغي: They blamed one another and said: "Woe to us! We were transgressors. Perhaps our Lord will give us something better in its place. We turn to our Lord in hope."
We give the poor their right and are not stingy.
We say "if Allah wills" about what we intend to do.
When we make a mistake we repent and return to Allah.
ماذا أراد أصحاب الحديقة؟: What did the owners of the garden want?
أن يوزّعوها على الناس: To share it with the people
ماذا قال أعدلهم؟: What did the fairest of them say?
ألم أقل لكم لولا تسبّحون: Did I not tell you to glorify Allah?
ماذا قالوا بعد أن رأوا الحديقة؟: What did they say after they saw the garden?
سبحان ربنا إنا كنا ظالمين: Glory to our Lord! We were wrong
سنعيد بناءها وحدنا: We will rebuild it by ourselves
أمر الله بني إسرائيل على لسان موسى أن يذ: Allah commanded the Children of Israel, through Musa, to sacrifice a cow. They thought he was joking, so he said: "I seek refuge with Allah from being among the ignorant."
ثم أخذوا يسألون: ما هي؟ وما لونها؟ فجاءه: Then they kept asking: "What kind is it? What colour?" The answer came: a bright yellow cow, pleasing to those who look at it.
وقالوا: وإنّا إن شاء الله لمهتدون. فقيل: They said: "If Allah wills, we will be guided." They were told: a cow not used to plough the land or water the crops, sound and without blemish.
So they sacrificed it, though they almost did not.
ثم أمرهم الله أن يضربوا القتيل ببعضها، ل: Then Allah told them to strike the dead man with a part of it, to show them how Allah gives life to the dead, so that they may understand.
نطيع أمر الله بسرعة ولا نكثر الجدال والت: We obey Allah's command quickly, without too much arguing or complicating.
Allah is able to bring the dead back to life.
We say "if Allah wills" about what we want to do.
بماذا أمرهم الله أن يذبحوا؟: What did Allah tell them to sacrifice?
ماذا أراهم الله بذلك؟: What did Allah show them by this?

From the creation of Adam to the destruction of Nuh's people by the Flood.
عاد وثمود، وكلتاهما جاءت «خلفاء» بعد من: Ad and Thamud, each described by the Quran as successors after those before them.
عصر إبراهيم وذريته: The age of Ibrahim and his descendants
إبراهيم ومعاصروه، ثم إسماعيل وإسحاق ويعق: Ibrahim and his contemporaries, then Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqub and Yusuf.
ترتيبهم هنا اجتهادي، فلا نصّ يحدّد سنة ب: Their order here is an estimate; no text fixes the year of their mission.

The last prophets of the Children of Israel.
Makkah and Arabia before the Quran was revealed.

أول البشر وأبو الناس: خلقه الله من طين و: The first human being and father of mankind: God created him from clay, had the angels prostrate to him, made him a vicegerent on earth, settled him in Paradise, then sent him down to earth.
A truthful prophet whom God raised to a lofty station.
ذكره القرآن باسمه ووصفه دون تحديد زمنه؛: The Quran names him and describes him without fixing his time; that he came between Adam and Nuh is the view of many scholars, while others differ.
أول رسول إلى أهل الأرض بعد أن شاع الشرك: The first messenger to the people of earth after polytheism spread; he called his people for nine hundred and fifty years and built the Ark by God's revelation, saving himself and the believers.

نبي أُرسل إلى عاد، دعاهم إلى عبادة الله: A prophet sent to Ad; he called them to worship God alone and reminded them of His favours, but they were arrogant.
أمة شديدة القوة بنت الأبنية الشامخة، جعل: A people of great strength who raised lofty buildings, made "successors after the people of Nuh"; they denied Hud and were destroyed by a furious, violent wind. Scholars differ on "Iram of the pillars": a city of theirs or the name of their tribe.
نبي ثمود: آتاه الله الناقة آية، فعقروها: The prophet of Thamud: God gave him the she-camel as a sign; they hamstrung her and the Cry seized them.
قوم ينحتون الجبال بيوتاً بالحِجر، جعلهم: A people who carved homes out of mountains at al-Hijr, made "successors after Ad"; they denied Salih, killed the she-camel and God destroyed them.
ذُكرت ثمود في وثائق قديمة منها نقش آشوري: Thamud appears in ancient records, including an Assyrian inscription from about # BCE; this does not fix the time of their messenger.

قوم لوط (المؤتفكات): The people of Lut (the overturned cities)
أتوا الفاحشة ما سبقهم بها أحد من العالمي: They committed an indecency no one in the worlds had preceded them in; God overturned their towns and rained upon them stones of baked clay, as a sign. Reports place their ruins near the Dead Sea.
ابن إبراهيم؛ أسكنه أبوه بوادٍ غير ذي زرع: Ibrahim's son; his father settled him in a valley without crops by the Sacred House, and together they raised the House's foundations. Scholars differ on who the sacrificial son was; the best-known view is Ismail.
بشّرت الملائكة إبراهيم بإسحاق ومن ورائه: The angels gave Ibrahim glad tidings of Ishaq and, after him, Yaqub; from Yaqub's offspring came the tribes and the Children of Israel (Israel is Yaqub).

أبواب الصدقة واسعة: التسبيح والتكبير وال: The doors of charity are wide: glorifying, magnifying, praising, saying there is no god but Allah, enjoining good and forbidding wrong, even lawful intimacy; the rich do not alone take the reward.
كل سلامى من الناس عليه صدقة: Every joint of a person owes a charity
شكر نعمة المفاصل بصدقة كل يوم: العدل بين: Gratitude for the joints is a daily charity: justice between two, helping with a mount, the good word, a step to prayer, and removing harm from the road.
البر حسن الخلق والإثم ما حاك في الصدر: Righteousness is good character and sin is what troubles the heart
حسن الخلق عنوان البر؛ والإثم ما ضاق به ا: Good character is the sign of righteousness; sin is what constricts the chest and what you dislike people finding out.
أوصيكم بتقوى الله والسمع والطاعة: I advise you to fear Allah, to hear and obey
وصية مودّع: التقوى والسمع والطاعة لولي ا: A farewell counsel: piety, hearing and obeying the ruler, holding fast to the Sunnah of the Prophet ﷺ and his rightly-guided successors, and beware of newly invented matters.
ألا أدلك على أبواب الخير: Shall I not guide you to the doors of good?
حديث معاذ: دخول الجنة بالعمل بأركان الإس: The hadith of Mu‘adh: entering Paradise by the pillars of Islam, then voluntary fasting, charity and night prayer, and guarding the tongue; people are thrown into the Fire only because of the harvest of their tongues.
ازهد في الدنيا يحبك الله: Be detached from the world and Allah will love you
الزهد في الدنيا سبب لمحبة الله، والزهد ف: Detachment from the world earns Allah’s love, and detachment from what is in people’s hands earns their love; it does not mean abandoning the world but not binding the heart to it.
لا ضرر ولا ضرار: There is no harm and no reciprocating harm
من القواعد الكبرى في الفقه: لا يُلحَق ال: One of the great maxims of jurisprudence: harm may neither be initiated nor answered with the like; many rulings on neighbours and transactions rest on it.
البينة على المدعي واليمين على من أنكر: The claimant must bring proof and the denier takes an oath
أصل في القضاء: لا تُقبل الدعاوى بمجرد ال: A foundation of adjudication: claims are not accepted on mere assertion, or people would claim others’ lives and wealth; proof is on the claimant and the oath on the defendant.
من رأى منكم منكراً فليغيره: Whoever sees a wrong should change it
ثلاث مراتب لإنكار المنكر بحسب القدرة: با: Three levels of forbidding wrong according to ability: by hand, then by tongue, then by the heart — and that is the weakest of faith.
لا تحاسدوا ولا تباغضوا: Do not envy one another and do not hate one another
حقوق الأخوة الإسلامية: ترك الحسد والتناج: The rights of Muslim brotherhood: abandon envy, bidding up, hatred, turning away and selling over another’s sale; be servants of Allah and brothers; a Muslim does not wrong, abandon or look down on his brother.
من نفّس عن مؤمن كربة: Whoever relieves a believer of a distress
ثواب الإعانة والستر والتيسير والتعلم وال: The reward of helping, covering faults, easing, seeking knowledge and gathering over the Book of Allah; the reward matches the deed.
إن الله كتب الحسنات والسيئات: Allah has written down the good and the bad deeds
فضل الله على عباده: من هم بحسنة فلم يعمل: Allah’s bounty to His servants: whoever intends a good deed but does not do it has a full good deed written; if he does it, ten to seven hundred times and more; whoever intends a bad deed and does not do it has a good deed written; if he does it, one bad deed.
من عادى لي ولياً فقد آذنته بالحرب: Whoever shows enmity to a friend of Mine, I declare war on him
حديث الولاية: ما تقرب العبد بأحب من الفر: The hadith of closeness: nothing brings a servant nearer than the obligations, then voluntary deeds, until Allah loves him and guides his hearing, sight, hand and foot, and answers his prayer.
إن الله وضع عن أمتي الخطأ والنسيان: Allah has lifted from my nation error, forgetfulness and what they were forced to do
من رحمة الله بهذه الأمة رفع المؤاخذة عن: Among Allah’s mercy to this nation is lifting accountability for error, forgetfulness and coercion; it is a foundation in the rules of liability.
كن في الدنيا كأنك غريب أو عابر سبيل: Be in this world as though you were a stranger or a wayfarer
توجيه إلى قصر الأمل والاستعداد للرحيل؛ ف: A directive to shorten hope and prepare for departure; a stranger does not cling to the land of his exile, and a traveller takes provisions for the road.
يا ابن آدم لو بلغت ذنوبك عنان السماء: O son of Adam, even if your sins reached the clouds of the sky
سعة مغفرة الله: الدعاء والرجاء سبب للغفر: The vastness of Allah’s forgiveness: supplication and hope bring forgiveness however great the sin, as long as one does not associate anything with Allah.
الإسلام والإيمان والإحسان، والقدر، والاس: Islam, faith and excellence (ihsan), divine decree, steadfastness, and the servant’s nearness to his Lord and repentance.
قبول العمل مشروط بالإخلاص لله وبموافقة س: A deed is accepted only with sincerity for Allah and agreement with the way of His Messenger ﷺ.
الحلال والحرام والورع والزهد: The lawful, the forbidden, scrupulousness and detachment
الحلال والشبهات وطيب الكسب، وترك ما لا ي: The lawful and the doubtful, pure earnings, leaving what does not concern one, detachment from the world, and the removal of hardship and harm.
النصيحة والمحبة وحسن الجوار والكلمة الطي: Sincere advice, love, good neighbourliness, the good word, modesty, good character and the rights of a Muslim over his brother.
الطهارة والذكر والصدقة بأنواعها وأبواب ا: Purification, remembrance, the many forms of charity, the doors of good, excellence in all things, and how good and bad deeds are recorded.
عصمة الدماء، والبينة واليمين في الخصومات: The sanctity of life, proof and oath in disputes, and the levels of forbidding wrong.
حديثان لم يُضمَّنا في مشكاة: Two hadiths not bundled in Mishkat
حديثان ذكرهما النووي وليسا في الكتب الست: Two hadiths al-Nawawi included that are not in the six books bundled in the app, so their texts are not quoted here.
إن الله فرض فرائض فلا تضيعوها: Allah has laid down obligations, so do not neglect them
ذكره النووي في الأربعين برقم #، وليس في: Al-Nawawi included it as number 41. It is not in the six books bundled in Mishkat, so its text is not quoted and nothing is attributed to it here. See al-Nawawi’s Forty Hadith and its commentaries.
لا يؤمن أحدكم حتى يكون هواه تبعاً لما جئ: None of you believes until his desires follow what I have brought
نسخ الحكم مع بقاء التلاوة: Abrogation of the ruling with the wording kept
يُرفع الحكم وتبقى الآية تُتلى؛ وهو أكثر: The ruling is lifted while the verse is still recited; this is the most common type, like the one-year widow period (2:240) replaced by four months and ten days (2:234).
نسخ التلاوة مع بقاء الحكم: Abrogation of the wording with the ruling kept
ترتفع الآية من المصحف ويبقى حكمها معمولا: The verse is lifted from the written text while its ruling remains; scholars give the stoning verse as an example, which Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, said had been revealed and its ruling continued.
نسخ الحكم والتلاوة معاً: Abrogation of both ruling and wording
يُرفع الحكم وترتفع التلاوة معاً، كما في: Both the ruling and the wording are lifted, as in the hadith of Aisha, may Allah be pleased with her: "ten known sucklings…, then abrogated by five known."
حقيقة النسخ وأقسامه: What abrogation is, and its types
النسخ في اصطلاح العلماء: رفع حكم شرعي بد: In the scholars’ usage, abrogation (naskh) is the lifting of a legal ruling by a later legal proof. The Quran points to it in verses such as "We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring one better than it or similar to it"; it reflects the gradual unfolding of legislation and Allah’s mercy toward His servants. It has types by what is lifted: the ruling, the wording, or both.
نص الآية الأصل في النسخ؛ والمراد بها عند: The foundational verse on abrogation; most commentators take it to mean the replacement of rulings with what is better for the servants or similar.
يمحو الله ما يشاء ويثبت: Allah erases what He wills and confirms
محو وإثبات بإرادة الله وحكمته، وعنده أصل: Allah erases and confirms what He wills by His wisdom, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.
وإذا بدلنا آية مكان آية: When We substitute a verse in place of a verse
تنبيه إلى أن التبديل يقع في الأحكام، وأن: A reminder that substitution happens in rulings, and that the idolaters’ charge of fabrication is false since Allah knows best what He sends down.
عشر رضعات ثم نُسخن بخمس: نسخ الحكم والتل: Ten sucklings, then abrogated by five: ruling and wording both lifted
حديث عائشة في الرضاع يصوّر القسم الثالث:: Aisha’s hadith on suckling pictures the third type: the ruling and wording of "ten" were lifted and the ruling of "five" remained. It is in Sahih Muslim.
آية الرجم: نسخ التلاوة وبقاء الحكم: The stoning verse: wording lifted, ruling kept
من خطبة عمر رضي الله عنه: كان مما أنزل آ: From Umar’s sermon: the stoning verse was among what was revealed, and the ruling of stoning remained established by the Messenger ﷺ and the Companions after him.
أمثلة شاعت في كتب الناسخ والمنسوخ، يُقاب: Examples common in books on abrogation, setting the abrogated beside the abrogating with the commentators’ words. In some of them scholars differ on whether it is abrogation, specification or clarification; that follows in its own chapter.
المنسوخ استقبال بيت المقدس (وكان بالسنة): What was abrogated is facing Jerusalem (established by the Sunnah); the abrogating is the command to face the Sacred Mosque. Ibn Abbas counted it the first thing abrogated in the Quran, as Ibn Kathir reports.
البراء: حادثة تحويل القبلة: Al-Bara’: the change of the qibla
يروي البراء أن النبي ﷺ صلى إلى بيت المقد: Al-Bara’ reports that the Prophet ﷺ prayed toward Jerusalem for sixteen or seventeen months while loving that his qibla be toward the Kaaba.
عدة الوفاة: حول كامل ثم أربعة أشهر وعشر: Widow’s waiting period: a full year, then four months and ten days
المنسوخ عند الأكثرين آية الحول (#) والنا: Most scholars hold that the one-year verse (240) is abrogated by the four-months-and-ten-days verse (234), though the abrogating comes earlier in the mushaf order. Al-Saadi saw the two verses as dealing with different matters, so no abrogation.
ابن الزبير وعثمان في آية الحول: Ibn al-Zubayr and Uthman on the one-year verse
سؤال ابن الزبير عثمان: لِمَ لم تكتب الآي: Ibn al-Zubayr asked Uthman why the abrogated verse was kept in writing; he replied that he does not move anything from its place — showing the order of the mushaf is by instruction.
كانت الوصية للوالدين والأقربين فرضاً، ثم: A bequest to parents and relatives was obligatory; then the inheritance verses came and Allah Himself set the shares, and the hadith says "no bequest to an heir".
حديث في خطبة حجة الوداع يبيّن أن الله أع: A hadith from the farewell sermon: Allah has given every rightful person his due in inheritance, so there is no bequest to an heir.
ثبات الواحد للعشرة ثم للاثنين: One standing against ten, then against two
أُمر المسلم أولاً بمقاومة عشرة، فشقّ ذلك: A Muslim was first told to stand against ten, which was hard, so it was eased to standing against two, and the good news of victory remained.
الصدقة قبل مناجاة الرسول ﷺ: Charity before private counsel with the Messenger
فُرضت الصدقة بين يدي النجوى ثم نُسخت تخف: Charity before private counsel was prescribed, then lifted in mercy by the verse "Are you afraid…"; it is reported that Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, acted upon it.
أُمر النبي ﷺ والمسلمون بقيام الليل إلا ق: The Prophet ﷺ and the Muslims were commanded to stand most of the night, then it was eased at the end of the surah, and the commentators say it was replaced by the five prayers.
الفدية لمن أراد ثم تعيّن الصوم: Ransom by choice, then fasting made binding
كان القادر على الصيام مخيَّراً بين الصوم: Those able to fast were at first given a choice between fasting and a ransom, then fasting became binding by "whoever witnesses the month, let him fast it", while the allowance for the sick and traveller remained.
سلمة بن الأكوع: نسخ التخيير بين الصوم وا: Salama ibn al-Akwa‘: the choice between fasting and ransom abrogated
حديث صريح في النسخ: كان من أراد أن يفطر: An explicit hadith on abrogation: whoever wished could break the fast and give a ransom, until the next verse came and abrogated it.
حدّ الزنا: الحبس والأذى ثم الجلد والرجم: Punishment for illegal intercourse: confinement and rebuke, then lashing and stoning
كان الحكم أولاً الإمساك في البيوت والأذى: At first the ruling was confinement in the houses and rebuke; then Surah an-Nur came and Allah made a way for them: lashing and stoning.
الإعراض والصفح وآية السيف: Turning away, pardon and the verse of the sword
ذهب بعض العلماء إلى أن آية السيف نسخت ال: Some scholars held that the verse of the sword abrogated the verses speaking of turning away and bearing harm; there is a long dispute over whether that is abrogation or a clarification of different circumstances.
ما قيل بنسخه وفيه نظر: What was said to be abrogated, and is debated
ليس كل ما سُمّي «نسخاً» عند المتقدمين نس: Not everything early scholars called "naskh" is abrogation in the technical sense; they used the word for specification, restriction, exception and clarifying the general. That is why verified abrogations are fewer for later scholars, and opinions vary. This chapter gives verbatim words from a commentator who differs from the well-known view, to show the breadth of the disagreement.
آية عدة الوفاة بحول: The verse of the one-year period
اشتهر القول بنسخها، وبيّن السعدي أنها وص: It is widely held to be abrogated; al-Saadi explained it as a bequest urging the deceased’s family to keep his widow with them, without binding her to the year.
قال بعضهم إنها في الوالدين والأقربين غير: Some said it concerns non-inheriting parents and relatives, so it would be specified rather than abrogated.
قصة دخول القرية: في البقرة «وقلنا ادخلوا: The entering of the town: Al-Baqara has "We said: enter… eat… abundantly… enter the gate prostrating and say hittah… your wrongs, and We will increase", while Al-A‘raf has "it was said to them: dwell… and eat… and say hittah and enter the gate prostrating… your sins, We will increase". Watch the verbs, order and plurals.
أمر آدم بالسكنى والأكل من الجنة: «وقلنا…: The command to Adam to dwell and eat in the garden: "and We said… and eat from it abundantly" in Al-Baqara; "and O Adam… so eat from" in Al-A‘raf.
نجاة بني إسرائيل: «نجيناكم من آل فرعون ي: The rescue of the Children of Israel: "We saved you from Pharaoh’s people… slaughtering", while Ibrahim has "Moses said to his people: remember Allah’s favour… when He saved you… and slaughtering" with an added "and".
قولهم «حسبنا ما وجدنا عليه آباءنا»: في ا: Their saying "we follow what we found our fathers upon": Al-Baqara says "we found (alfaynā)" and Luqman says "we found (wajadnā)", followed by "even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze".
النهي عن قتل الأولاد: في الأنعام «من إمل: The prohibition of killing children: Al-An‘am says "from poverty — We provide for you and for them", Al-Isra says "for fear of poverty — We provide for them and for you". The first is poverty already present, the second fear of future poverty.
الإيمان بما أنزل: «قولوا آمنا بالله وما: Belief in what was sent down: "Say (plural): we believe in Allah and what was sent down to us… and what the prophets were given" in Al-Baqara; "Say (singular): we believe… what was sent down upon us… and the prophets" in Al Imran.
الذين آمنوا والذين هادوا والصابئين: «وال: "Those who believed, the Jews and the Sabians": Al-Baqara has "the Sabians… so they will have their reward with their Lord and no fear"; Al-Ma’ida has the Sabians in the nominative and "no fear".
«وإن تعدوا نعمة الله لا تحصوها»: في إبرا: "If you count Allah’s favours you cannot enumerate them": Ibrahim ends "indeed man is unjust and ungrateful", while An-Nahl ends "indeed Allah is Forgiving and Merciful".
«واتقوا يوما لا تجزي نفس عن نفس شيئا»: ف: "Fear a day when no soul will avail another": verse 48 mentions intercession then ransom; verse 123 mentions ransom then intercession.
«وما جعله الله إلا بشرى… وما النصر إلا م: "Allah made it only as good news… and victory is only from Allah": Al Imran has "for you and so your hearts may be at rest by it", while Al-Anfal has "good news and so your hearts may be at rest by it".
من البعثة إلى الهجرة: الوحي والدعوة السر: From the first revelation to the emigration: revelation, secret then open calling, patience under harm, and the Night Journey.
المرحلة المدنية والغزوات: The Medinan phase and the campaigns
من الهجرة إلى وفاته ﷺ: بناء المجتمع، وتح: From the emigration to his passing ﷺ: building the community, changing the qibla, the campaigns, the treaty and conquest, and the farewell pilgrimage.
بدء الوحي في غار حراء: The first revelation in the cave of Hira
رمضان، قبل الهجرة بنحو ثلاث عشرة سنة: Ramadan, about thirteen years before the emigration
كان النبي ﷺ يخلو بغار حراء، فجاءه جبريل: The Prophet ﷺ used to retreat to the cave of Hira, where Jibril came to him with the first of the Quran to descend, on the best-known view: "Read in the name of your Lord who created". Revelation then paused for a time and "O you who is covered" came, beginning the charge to warn.
أول ما نزل على أشهر الأقوال: أمر بالقراء: The first to descend on the best-known view: a command to read in the name of the Creator, honouring knowledge and the pen.
بعد فترة الوحي: بدء الأمر بالقيام بالإنذ: After the pause of revelation: the beginning of the command to rise and warn, magnify, purify and be patient.
حديث عائشة في بدء الوحي: Aisha’s hadith on the beginning of revelation
يصف بدء الوحي بالرؤيا الصادقة ثم تحنث غا: It describes the start of revelation with true dreams, the retreat at Hira, Jibril’s coming, and Khadija’s reassurance to the Messenger ﷺ.
قبل الهجرة بنحو عشر سنين: About ten years before the emigration
بعد سنوات من الدعوة الخفية أُمر النبي ﷺ: After years of private calling the Prophet ﷺ was commanded to warn his nearest kin, then to proclaim the message openly; he climbed as-Safa and called Quraysh.
أمر بإنذار الأقربين ولين الجانب للمؤمنين: A command to warn the nearest kin and be gentle with the believers, while disowning disobedience.
الصدع: الجهر والإظهار، مع الإعراض عن الم: To proclaim openly, while turning away from the idolaters.
يروي ابن عباس أن النبي ﷺ صعد الصفا ونادى: Ibn Abbas reports that the Prophet ﷺ climbed as-Safa, called the clans of Quraysh and asked: if I told you that cavalry is about to raid you, would you believe me? They said: we have found nothing but truth from you.
قبل الهجرة، واختُلف في تعيين وقته: Before the emigration; its exact time is disputed
أُسري بالنبي ﷺ من المسجد الحرام إلى المس: The Prophet ﷺ was taken by night from the Sacred Mosque to the Farthest Mosque, then ascended through the heavens, where the five prayers were made obligatory.
نص الإسراء: تنزيه لله وبيان لقدرته، وتشر: The text of the Night Journey: glorifying Allah, showing His power, and honouring the Prophet ﷺ with servanthood.
ائتمرت قريش على النبي ﷺ فنجّاه الله، وخر: Quraysh plotted against the Prophet ﷺ, Allah saved him, and he left with Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, may Allah be pleased with him; they hid in the cave of Thawr, then reached Medina.
مكر قريش بالنبي ﷺ بين الحبس والقتل والإخ: Quraysh’s plot against the Prophet ﷺ — to imprison, kill or expel him — while Allah’s plan is best.
الغار: صاحبه أبو بكر، وسكينة الله عليه:: The cave: his companion was Abu Bakr, with Allah’s tranquillity upon him: "Do not grieve; Allah is with us".
قال أبو بكر: لو أن أحدهم رفع قدمه رآنا،: Abu Bakr said: if one of them raised his foot he would see us; the Prophet ﷺ said: what do you think of two whose third is Allah?
السنة الثانية للهجرة بعد أشهر من القدوم: Year 2 AH, some months after arrival
صلّى النبي ﷺ إلى بيت المقدس نحو ستة عشر: The Prophet ﷺ prayed toward Jerusalem for about sixteen months while hoping to face the Kaaba; then the command came to face the Sacred Mosque.
إخبار بما سيقوله المعترضون على تحويل الق: A report of what objectors to the change would say, with the answer: to Allah belong the east and the west.
تحويل القبلة: قد نرى تقلب وجهك في السماء: The change itself: "We see the turning of your face toward the heaven, so We will turn you toward a qibla you will like."
يروي البراء أن النبي ﷺ صلى إلى بيت المقد: Al-Bara’ reports that the Prophet ﷺ prayed toward Jerusalem for sixteen or seventeen months, then was directed to the Kaaba, and the worshippers turned as they were during prayer.
التقى نحو ثلاثمائة وبضعة عشر مسلماً بجيش: About three hundred and a few Muslims met the army of Quraysh at Badr; Allah gave them victory despite their small number and supported them with angels. It was the first decisive battle between faith and disbelief.
وعد الله بإحدى الطائفتين: العير أو النفي: Allah’s promise of one of two parties — the caravan or the army — and His will to establish the truth.
استغاثة النبي ﷺ والمسلمين، فأمدّهم الله: The supplication of the Prophet ﷺ and the Muslims, answered by a thousand angels following one another.
أثر النصر من الله لا من الأسباب وحدها: «: The victory is from Allah, not from means alone: "but it was Allah who threw".
A reminder of the victory at Badr when they were weak, so that they may be grateful.
دعاء النبي ﷺ يوم بدر: The Prophet’s supplication on the day of Badr
عدد المشركين ألف والمسلمين ثلاثمائة وتسع: The idolaters were a thousand and the Muslims 319; the Prophet ﷺ faced the qibla, stretched out his hands calling on his Lord until his cloak fell, and Allah supported him with angels.
خرجت قريش ثأراً ليوم بدر، فأقام النبي ﷺ: Quraysh marched to avenge Badr. The Prophet ﷺ stationed archers on the hill and ordered them not to leave their positions; some descended for the spoils, the lines broke and the Muslims suffered losses. Many verses of Surah Al Imran were revealed to draw its lessons.
تذكير بخروج النبي ﷺ لتبوئة المؤمنين مقاع: A reminder of the Prophet’s going out to station the believers in positions for battle.
تثبيت للمؤمنين بعد الهزيمة: إن كنتم مؤمن: Reassurance after the setback: if you are believers you are the uppermost, and such days We rotate among people.
بيان أثر ترك الموقع وطلب الدنيا بعد نصر: It explains the effect of leaving the post and seeking the world after the initial victory.
Drowsiness as a tranquillity upon those who stood firm in the battle.
البراء: الرماة وأبو سفيان يوم أحد: Al-Bara’: the archers and Abu Sufyan at Uhud
يروي البراء كيف أجلس النبي ﷺ الرماة وأمر: Al-Bara’ tells how the Prophet ﷺ stationed the archers and ordered them to hold, then their departure for spoils and what befell the Muslims.
شوال، السنة الخامسة للهجرة على الأشهر: Shawwal, year 5 AH on the better-known view

Ibrahim's being tried with commands and his fulfilling them.

آمن بإبراهيم وأُرسل إلى قوم يأتون الفاحش: He believed in Ibrahim and was sent to a people who committed an abomination. He forbade them and they did not respond, so Allah saved him and his family except his wife, and rained on his people stones of baked clay.
Lut forbidding his people the innovated abomination.
بُشّر به إبراهيم وهو حليم، وصبر لأمر الل: Ibrahim was given glad tidings of him as a forbearing boy. He was patient with Allah's command when his father saw in a dream that he was slaughtering him, and he helped his father raise the foundations of the House. Allah described him as true to his promise, commanding his family to prayer and zakah.
Allah's praise of Isma'il and the mention of his descendants.
بشّرت به الملائكة إبراهيم وزوجته سارة عل: The angels gave Ibrahim and his wife Sarah glad tidings of him in old age. He is described as a prophet among the righteous, and Allah made many prophets of his descendants.
The glad tidings of Ishaq and his prophethood.
وصّى بنيه بالتوحيد وهو يحتضر، وابتُلي بف: He charged his sons with monotheism as he lay dying. He was tried by the loss of his son Yusuf and then his brother and bore it with beautiful patience; his eyes whitened with grief, then Allah reunited him with them.
وصية إبراهيم لبنيه ثم وصية يعقوب بالإسلا: Ibrahim's charge to his sons, then Yaqub's charge of Islam.
إخوته وأهل مصر: His brothers and the people of Egypt
رأى أحد عشر كوكباً ساجدةً له، فكاده إخوت: He saw eleven stars prostrating to him; his brothers plotted against him and threw him into the well. He was sold in Egypt, resisted the seduction of the governor's wife and was imprisoned, then Allah established him in the land and reunited him with his parents and brothers.
اجتباء الله ليوسف وتعليمه تأويل الأحاديث: Allah's choosing Yusuf and teaching him the interpretation of events.
جاء قومه بالبينات: Came to his people with clear proofs
ابتُلي في جسده وأهله وماله فصبر، ونادى ر: He was tried in his body, family and wealth and was patient. He called on his Lord: "Affliction has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful." So Allah answered him, removed his harm and gave him back his family and the like of them with them, as mercy from Him and a reminder for the worshippers.
أهل مدين وأصحاب الأيكة: The people of Madyan and the companions of the thicket
أُرسل إلى مدين وأصحاب الأيكة يدعوهم إلى: He was sent to Madyan and the companions of the thicket, calling them to monotheism and forbidding cheating in measure and weight. They denied him, so the quake and the punishment of the Day of the Shadow seized them.
إرسال شعيب إلى مدين وإخلاص العبادة وترك: The sending of Shu'ayb to Madyan, sincere worship and leaving cheating.
فرعون وملؤه، وبنو إسرائيل: Pharaoh and his chiefs, and the Children of Israel
ألقته أمه في اليم فالتقطه آل فرعون، ثم ف: His mother cast him into the river and Pharaoh's household picked him up. He later fled to Madyan; his Lord spoke to him at the Mount, and he was sent to Pharaoh with signs. Allah saved the Children of Israel, drowned Pharaoh and his soldiers, and revealed the Torah to him.
Allah's call to Musa at the sacred valley.
فرعون وبنو إسرائيل: Pharaoh and the Children of Israel
سأل موسى ربه أن يجعل له وزيراً من أهله ه: Musa asked his Lord to appoint for him an aide from his family, Harun his brother, and make him a partner in his task. Allah granted it and sent him with Musa to Pharaoh; Musa left him in charge of the Children of Israel when he went to meet his Lord.
Musa's supplication that Harun share in his task.
من الصابرين الأخيار: Among the patient and the best
ذكره الله مع إسماعيل وإدريس من الصابرين: Allah mentions him with Isma'il and Idris among the patient and among the best whom He admitted into His mercy; the Quran does not detail his story, and the exegetes differ about his prophethood as in the quotation below.
The exegetes' difference on the prophethood of Dhul-Kifl.
قتل جالوت، وآتاه الله الملك والحكمة وعلّ: He killed Jalut (Goliath); Allah gave him kingship and wisdom and taught him what He willed, made the mountains and birds glorify with him, softened iron for him to make coats of mail, and revealed the Zabur to him.
Dawud's worship and turning to his Lord.
بنو إسرائيل وملكة سبأ: The Children of Israel and the queen of Saba'
ورث داود، وعلّمه الله منطق الطير، وسخّر: He inherited Dawud; Allah taught him the speech of birds, subjected to him the wind, the jinn and the devils, and he understood the speech of the ant. The hoopoe brought him news of the queen of Saba', whom he called to Allah, and she submitted with him.
Sulayman inheriting Dawud's knowledge and prophethood.
أُرسل إلى قوم يعبدون صنماً اسمه بعل، فأم: He was sent to a people who worshipped an idol called Ba'l, commanding them to be mindful of Allah and worship Him alone; they denied him. Allah praised him and left for him a good mention among later generations.
Ilyas's call to abandon the worship of Ba'l.
ذكره الله في عداد الأنبياء الذين فضّلهم: Allah mentions him among the prophets He favoured over the worlds and among the best; the Quran does not detail his story.
The mention of al-Yasa' with Isma'il and Dhul-Kifl.
ممن آتاهم الله الكتاب والحكم والنبوة: Among those Allah gave the Book, judgement and prophethood
قومه (ويذكر المفسرون أنهم أهل نينوى): His people (the exegetes say they were the people of Nineveh)
ذهب مغاضباً فالتقمه الحوت، فنادى في الظل: He left in anger and the whale swallowed him; he called out in the darknesses: "There is no god but You, glory be to You; I was among the wrongdoers." Allah saved him, and his people all believed, so He let them enjoy life for a time.
The sending of Yunus to his people and his warning of punishment.
كفل مريم وكان يجد عندها رزقاً، فنادى ربه: He took Maryam into his care and found provision with her. He called his Lord a hidden call to grant him an heir in old age; Allah gave him glad tidings of Yahya and made as his sign that he would not speak to people for three nights though sound.
Allah's choosing Zakariyya and his carrying out the message.
وهبه الله لزكريا، وأمره أن يأخذ الكتاب ب: Allah granted him to Zakariyya and commanded him to hold the Book firmly, gave him judgement as a boy, tenderness from Him and purity. He was dutiful to his parents and pious, and peace was upon him the day he was born, the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
Yahya taking the Book with strength.
وُلد من مريم بلا أب، وتكلّم في المهد، وآ: He was born of Maryam without a father and spoke in the cradle. Allah gave him the Injil, supported him with the Holy Spirit and with signs, among them raising the dead by Allah's leave; the disciples helped him, and Allah raised him to Himself, and they neither killed nor crucified him.
Isa's speech in the cradle as a sign of his truthfulness and prophethood.
أُرسل رحمةً للعالمين وأُنزل عليه القرآن،: He was sent as a mercy to the worlds and the Quran was revealed to him; Allah addressed him with prophethood and messengership, prophethood was sealed with him, and his message is to all people.
The standing of the Prophet ﷺ and his message.
رسول الله وخاتم النبيين: Messenger of Allah and Seal of the Prophets
الأنبياء إخوة لعلّات: The prophets are brothers of one father
دين الأنبياء واحد في أصله وهو التوحيد، و: The religion of the prophets is one in its root, which is monotheism, though their laws differ, like brothers from one father and different mothers.
مثل النبوة كبناء إلا لبنة: Prophethood likened to a building but one brick
تمثيل لاكتمال بناء النبوات بمحمد ﷺ؛ فهو: A comparison showing that the building of prophethood is complete with Muhammad ﷺ, who is the brick that completes it.
لا نبي بعدي: There is no prophet after me
كان بنو إسرائيل يُقاد أمرهم بالأنبياء كل: The Children of Israel were governed by prophets, each followed by another; this community has no prophet after its Prophet.
الآيات والوحي: The signs given to the prophets and the revelation
أعظم ما أُوتيه النبي ﷺ وحي يُتلى باقٍ إل: The greatest thing the Prophet ﷺ was given is a revelation recited and preserved until the Day of Resurrection, so he has the most followers.
الرعي تهذيب للنفس بالصبر والرفق قبل رعاي: Shepherding trains the self in patience and gentleness before caring for people; the Prophet ﷺ tended sheep like the others.
ولكن ليطمئن قلبي: But to put my heart at rest
سؤال إبراهيم عليه السلام لم يكن شكّاً بل: Ibrahim's question was not doubt but a request for greater reassurance by seeing what he already believed.
يرحم الله لوطاً: May Allah have mercy on Lut
ثناء على صبر يوسف عليه السلام في السجن و: Praise for Yusuf's patience in prison and for what Lut wished of a strong support.
الكريم ابن الكريم: The noble son of the noble
يوسف عليه السلام هو الرابع في سلسلة الكر: Yusuf, peace be upon him, is the fourth in a line of nobility and prophethood: Yusuf son of Yaqub son of Ishaq son of Ibrahim.
يأكل من عمل يده: He ate from the work of his hand
مع ما آتاه الله من الملك كان داود عليه ا: Despite the kingship Allah gave him, Dawud ate from his own earnings, which shows the virtue of manual work.
خُفّف على داود القرآن: Recitation was made light for Dawud
والمراد بالقرآن هنا الزبور، وكان يقرؤه ف: The "Quran" here means the Zabur; he would recite it in a short time and then eat from the work of his hand.
نبي نزل تحت شجرة فلدغته نملة: A prophet stopped under a tree and an ant bit him
عتاب لنبي على أن عاقب أمة بسبب أذى واحدة: A reproach to a prophet for punishing a whole community for the harm of one of them; the hadith does not name the prophet.
حرص أيوب عليه السلام على بركة الله وفضله: Ayyub's eagerness for Allah's blessing and favour, and that a servant is never free of need of it however great his wealth.
لا تفضّلوني على يونس: It is not fitting to say: I am better than Yunus
نهي عن الاستعلاء على نبي من الأنبياء؛ فك: A prohibition on belittling any of the prophets; all of them were given virtue.
رحمة الله على موسى: May Allah have mercy on Musa
تسلية للنبي ﷺ بصبر موسى عليه السلام على: Consolation for the Prophet ﷺ by the patience of Musa, peace be upon him, with his people's harm.
خلق الله آدم وطوله ستون ذراعاً: Allah created Adam sixty cubits tall
أول تحية بين آدم والملائكة هي «السلام عل: The first greeting between Adam and the angels is "peace be upon you", a practice for his descendants after him.
عصمة مريم وابنها عيسى عليهما السلام من م: Maryam and her son Isa, peace be upon them, were protected from Satan's touch at birth, in answer to the supplication of Maryam's mother.
The definition of messenger and prophet according to the authors of al-Jalalayn.
The difference between the two descriptions according to al-Sa'di.
The best-known view on counting those of firm resolve.
The well-known count in al-Tafsir al-Muyassar.
Mujahid's view on those of firm resolve.
A view that all the messengers were of firm resolve.
قيام الحجة بالرسل على كل الأمم ووحدة دعو: The establishment of proof by messengers on every nation and the unity of their call.
The great number of messengers and those whose story was not told.
Why the Quran did not name the town.
The two messengers being strengthened by a third.
طلبهم من نبيهم تعيين ملك، والنبي هنا غير: Their asking their prophet to appoint a king; the prophet is not named in the verse.
The different identifications of the one who passed by the town.
Al-Sa'di's view on the righteous servant.
The rank of the Seal ﷺ.

Every quotation is labelled with its type, book and author.
ترجيحات المفسرين واستنباطاتهم وتحرير أقو: The exegetes' preferences, inferences and critical analysis of views on the theme's verses, quoted verbatim.
اجتهاد من المفسر لا يُجزم به، يُستأنس به: The exegete's own reasoning, not to be asserted as certain: take it as a gentle aid, never as the basis of a ruling.

What is quoted under «Subtle insights» is the exegete's own reasoning and is not asserted as certain.
أصل الدين وأعظم موضوعات القرآن: إثبات ال: The foundation of the religion and the greatest theme of the Quran: affirming God's oneness, knowing Him by His names and attributes, rejecting shirk, and sincerity and reliance in deeds.
منظومة الفضائل التي أمر بها القرآن: صدق: The system of virtues the Quran commands: truthfulness and trust, patience and justice, mercy and forgiveness, humility and dutifulness.
قصص الأنبياء والصالحين: مواضعها في القرآ: Stories of the prophets and the righteous: where they occur in the Quran, with their lessons and guidance, through the exegetes' words.
آيات الأحكام العملية مبوّبة: العبادات وا: Practical rulings arranged by chapter: worship, transactions, family and penal law, with juristic quotations from the classical tafsirs.
الله واحد لا شريك له في ذاته ولا صفاته و: God is One, with no partner in His essence, attributes, acts or worship; this is the word of tawhid around which the whole Quran revolves.
يعرّفنا القرآن بربنا بأسمائه الحسنى وصفا: The Quran makes us know our Lord by His most beautiful names and most exalted attributes, commands us to call upon Him by them, and to affirm them as they came, without likening or negating.
يستدل القرآن على وحدانية الله بآياته في: The Quran argues for God's oneness from His signs in creation: the heavens and the earth, night and day, rain and plants. He who created and governs deserves to be worshipped alone.
الشرك أعظم الذنوب وأقبحها، لا يغفره الله: Shirk is the gravest and ugliest of sins; God does not forgive whoever dies upon it, and it voids deeds and destroys the foundation on which all other deeds stand.
الإخلاص أن يكون العمل لله وحده، والتوكل: Sincerity is that the deed be for God alone, and reliance is true dependence on God while taking the means; through both, servitude is realised.
الصدق في القول والعمل والوعد، وأداء الأم: Truthfulness in speech, deed and promise, and returning trusts to their owners, are among the believers' most distinctive traits and the strongest foundation of trust in society.
الصبر على الطاعة وعن المعصية وعلى أقدار: Patience in obedience, away from disobedience and under God's painful decrees; the Quran made it a help in every matter and promised the patient a reward without reckoning.
أمر القرآن بالعدل مع القريب والبعيد والص: The Quran commanded justice toward kin and stranger, friend and foe, and joined it to ihsan, which is giving more than what is due out of grace.
كظم الغيظ والعفو والصفح والإحسان إلى الم: Restraining anger, forgiving, pardoning and doing good to the one who wronged you are among the highest stations of character; they turn enmity into friendship and raise their possessor with God.
خفض الجناح ولين القول وترك السخرية والتج: Lowering the wing, gentle speech, and avoiding mockery, spying and backbiting are among the believer's manners with people, and traits of the servants of the Most Merciful.
قرن الله الإحسان إلى الوالدين بعبادته، و: God joined kindness to parents with His own worship, made dutifulness to them among the greatest acts of nearness, and required courtesy toward them and prayer for them even when beliefs differ.
قصة آدم عليه السلام: The story of Adam, peace be upon him
قصة خلق آدم عليه السلام وتكريمه، وسجود ا: The creation of Adam and his honouring, the angels' prostration to him, Iblis's refusal, and the descent to earth; in it lie the root of enmity and of repentance.
قصة نوح عليه السلام: The story of Nuh, peace be upon him
دعوة نوح عليه السلام قومه ألف سنة إلا خم: Nuh's call to his people for nine hundred and fifty years, his patience with them, the building of the ark and the flood, and the salvation of the believers.
قصة إبراهيم عليه السلام: The story of Ibrahim, peace be upon him
خليل الرحمن عليه السلام: محاجّته قومه وم: The Friend of the Most Merciful: his debate with his people and with the one God gave kingship, the breaking of the idols and his rescue from the fire, the building of the House, and the trial of the sacrifice.
قصة يوسف عليه السلام: The story of Yusuf, peace be upon him
قصة يوسف عليه السلام «أحسن القصص»: رؤياه: The story of Yusuf, «the best of stories»: his dream and his brothers' scheming, the temptation by the Aziz's wife and his patience and chastity, then empowerment and forgiveness.
قصة موسى عليه السلام: The story of Musa, peace be upon him
قصة موسى عليه السلام: مولده ونشأته في بي: Musa's birth and upbringing in Pharaoh's house, his leaving for Madyan, God's speaking to him and his mission to Pharaoh.
قصة مريم وعيسى عليهما السلام: The story of Maryam and Isa, peace be upon them
قصة مريم عليها السلام وكرامتها ومولد عيس: Maryam's honour, the birth of Isa and his miracles, and the Quran's clearing of both from exaggeration and neglect.
فتية آمنوا بربهم ففرّوا بدينهم إلى الكهف: Youths who believed in their Lord and fled with their religion to the cave; God protected them and sealed their ears for years. A lesson in steadfastness upon faith.
ملك صالح مكّن الله له في الأرض فسار شرقا: A righteous king whom God established in the earth; he travelled east and west helping the oppressed and built the barrier against Yajuj and Majuj, humble before God.
الصلاة عماد الدين وأعظم الأركان بعد الشه: Prayer is the pillar of the religion and the greatest pillar after the two testimonies; God ordained it at set times and commanded its preservation and the Friday prayer.
فُرض صيام رمضان على هذه الأمة كما فُرض ع: Fasting Ramadan was prescribed for this nation as it was for those before it, with a concession for the sick and the traveller, and the rulings on breaking the fast, the pre-dawn meal and retreat.
الزكاة حق الله في المال، ومصارفها ثمانية: Zakat is God's due in wealth, its recipients are eight by the text of the Quran, alongside the encouragement to spend good things in God's cause with sincerity.
الحج فريضة العمر لمن استطاع؛ وفي الآيات: Hajj is a once-in-a-lifetime duty for whoever is able; the verses give its rites, months, the rulings on expiation and sacrifice, standing at Arafah and remembering God there.
الآيات تنظّم الزواج والمعاشرة بالمعروف و: The verses organise marriage, kind companionship, divorce, waiting periods and return, protect the rights of women and children, and warn against injustice.
تحريم الربا وأحكام الدَّين والكتابة والش: The prohibition of usury, the rules of debt, writing, witnessing and pledge, the command to fulfil contracts, and consuming wealth by mutual consent, not by falsehood.
القصاص في القتل حياة للمجتمع، وحدّ السرق: Retribution in killing is life for society, with the penalties for theft and unlawful intercourse; the verses join punishment with pardon, mercy and the protection of the five essentials.
ما أحلّ الله من الطيبات وما حرّم من الخب: What God made lawful of good things and forbade of impurities (carrion, blood, pork and what is slaughtered for other than God), and the rules of slaughter and the food of the People of the Book.
